name: Korg NAUTILUS Global
description: Korg NAUTILUS: its Global settings (tuning, curves, controller assignments, user scales, audio inputs, MIDI) by SysEx parameter change, read back from Global.

sources.title: NAUTILUS MIDI Implementation: Global, object version 1
sources.notes: Rows read by tools/profiles/korg/read-kronos-table.mjs from SysExDumps/Global.txt (sha256 87d81f25b28ac00221fc8d45ce9c73fbeb9cffba52a1169c6bdcfe1e56ff38e6) in NAUTILUS_MIDIimp.zip of 2022-09-22, https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/873/4923/. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.

Every row of SysExDumps/Global.txt with a parameter id is a parameter, named by its group and its name as printed, and sent by Parameter Change (function 43): F0 42 3g 00 01 5D 43 TYP SOC SUB PID IDX and the value as 21 bits, two's complement, high byte first (*4). Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Global: tuning, curves, the controllers' assignments and polarities, the user scales, the audio inputs and the MIDI settings. The NAUTILUS takes global parameters in Global mode ("Which parameters are currently available for editing depends on the instrument's mode"). The effects' own parameters, which depend on the effect type (Effect.txt), are not here.

A range whose first value is the larger (9D~63) is two's complement over its bytes, -99~+99. A choice is a row naming both of two values. The value column is 19 characters wide; a name it cuts short keeps its cut, with an ellipsis. Other value names are in each parameter's description.

Left out: 2 settings (Controller Foot SW Assign; MIDI Start/Stop Out Enable): the table prints one id for Controller Foot SW Assign and MIDI Start/Stop Out Enable, unmarked, and does not say which value means which.
Left out: 2 settings (MIDI Midi Clock; Audio Analog Input 1 Gain): the table prints one id for MIDI Midi Clock and Audio Analog Input 1 Gain, unmarked, and does not say which value means which.

Pull: Current Object Dump Request (function 74) for object 03, the global, answered by a Current Object Dump (function 75) carrying object version 1 and 24706 bytes in Korg's 8-in-7 packing (*3: 28236 bytes). 598 parameters are read back at their rows' offsets and bits. A dump of any other length does not match.
Sent and not read back: 1 setting (MIDI Note Receive (bit 0, 00~02)): its bits are printed narrower than its range (`bit 0` for `00~02`), so where its value ends in the byte is not said.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.

Identity: the Device Inquiry reply (NAUTILUS_MIDI_MIDI_Implentaion.txt) is printed F0 7E 0g 06 02 42 00 01 5D 00 mm 00 vv ww xx 00 F7, 17 bytes where the universal reply has 15. Its 7th to 10th bytes, 00 01 5D 00, are checked as printed, where the universal reply puts the family and member code; its 11th byte, mm, is one per model and is not checked: NAUTILUS 61Keys 05H, NAUTILUS 73Keys 0EH, NAUTILUS 88Keys 17H.
No preset recall: the implementation prints no banks for this object.
